items.title: Axion-1.0 35B ships with its full open training recipe: model, training data, code and paper
items.summary: The Axion-1.0 team released a 35B model with the complete recipe behind it: weights on Hugging Face, the training dataset, the training code in a ByteDance GitHub repo, and a paper on Hugging Face Papers. Victor Mustar (Hugging Face) flagged it as a rare full-recipe release.

doubt.pushback: 70.2 against 70.0 is within normal run-to-run noise on SWE-bench Verified, and the paper does not report seed variance; replies also ask whether constraints set early in a task survive compaction.

items.reception: Mixed to positive across 20 replies read. Builders say it matches what they see in Claude Code and Codex compaction; the main pushback is on noise and on losing early instructions. No refutation seen.
items.title: NVIDIA paper: frequent context compaction keeps agent accuracy while cutting peak context about 4x
items.summary: NVIDIA tests aggressive compaction on long-horizon and long-input tasks. With one action per context, Claude Opus 4.5 scores 70.2 on SWE-bench Verified against 70.0 with full history, while median peak context falls from about 32K to 8K tokens. A simple compaction at the end of the run lifts the score from 70.0 to 74.8, and the paper notes later tokens can cost up to 7x more than early ones.

items.title: UCSD paper: context rot comes from look-alike statements, not from input length
items.summary: Adding 32K tokens of unrelated text left retrieval accuracy at 97 to 100% on Qwen2.5-1.5B, but adding statements that resemble the answer dropped it to 16 to 33%. Across 126,473 trials, attention on the correct passage explains up to 58% of errors against about 8% for length alone.

items.title: RSI-Dojo: training a model to run LLM post-training itself, with 281 tasks built from papers
items.summary: RSI-Craft turns research papers into executable post-training environments (datasets, metrics, eval code); 281 tasks survive filtering. Training on them lifts a 9B model by 8.74 points, and RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B gains 16.87 points to reach 29.95 on PostTrainBench.

items.reception: Positive but generic across 12 replies read; nobody reports trying it yet, and one reply asks how it differs from running Claude Code or Codex over papers. The 28s clip is a short demo, under the video threshold.
items.title: Paperclip Datasets: describe a dataset and have it curated from millions of papers
items.summary: James Zou's gxl.ai launches Paperclip Datasets, which builds structured datasets from the literature from a plain description. As a demo they release a 20k-measurement human drug half-life dataset covering 2,400+ drugs on Hugging Face.

doubt.pushback: The post links no sign-up page or rollout dataset yet, so access terms are unverified.

items.title: RoboColosseum: open robot eval initiative with 100+ robots and 10,000 free eval hours
items.summary: Hugging Face, BitRobot Network, EAIC and DJiafei launch RoboColosseum, offering evaluation on 100+ physical robots (Unitree G1, LeRobot SO-101, YAM, Franka and more) across 140+ in-the-wild scenes, with open rollout data and 10,000 free eval hours. This is the launch of the teaser skipped on Nov 2.

items.title: ggml v0.29.0 adds FP8 E4M3, per-row flash attention and early multi-node tensor parallelism
items.summary: New OCP FP8 E4M3 tensor type, ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows (each query slice attends to its own K/V rows), batched tensor copy APIs, and a multi-process communicator for multi-node tensor parallelism. Backend work includes SVE CPU kernels, fused MoE MMQ in CUDA, faster MXFP4 mat-vec in Metal and Vulkan split-K tuning.

items.title: Cohere Embed 5 and Rerank 5 now available on OpenRouter
items.summary: Cohere's Embed 5 and Rerank 5 are live on OpenRouter in Pro and Fast tiers, so retrieval pipelines can use them through the same API and bill as other OpenRouter models.

items.title: Aleph Alpha Kolibri 1 now supported in vLLM 0.33
items.summary: Kolibri 1 (kept Nov 3 for its reasoning-effort controls) now runs in vLLM 0.33, so it can be served with the same stack as other open models.
